title: Plugin details
description: The current Customizations plugin detail page: back navigation and plugin title, installed actions in the upper-right, Auto Update on its own row above Details, a manual Update action only when Auto Update is off, or a single Install action for marketplace plugins, plus Details, Contains, and README sections.
usage: Use as a section page inside the Customizations modal or docked editor. Add `uninstalled` for marketplace details with a single Install action. Listen for `back`, `install`, `update`, `uninstall`, `uninstall-menu`, `enablement-change`, and `auto-update-change`.

attributes.name: readme
attributes.default: No README was provided for this plugin.

attributes.name: update-available
attributes.description: Makes the manual Update action available while Auto Update is off.

attributes.name: auto-update
attributes.description: Initial Auto Update switch state. Suppresses the manual Update action while enabled.

attributes.name: uninstalled
attributes.description: Marketplace detail state with only an Install action.

states.name: installed
states.trigger: Default state: enablement and uninstall splits in the heading, Auto Update above Details, and an optional manual Update action.

states.name: uninstalled
states.trigger: Set `uninstalled`: only Install is shown and fires `install`.

states.name: auto-update
states.trigger: Click the Auto Update switch; fires `auto-update-change` and hides manual Update while enabled.

states.name: update
states.trigger: Click Update while Auto Update is off; fires `update`.
